options.rustpg.hud_enabled.tip: Shows RustPG health, stamina and XP bars.
options.rustpg.replace_vanilla.tip: Replaces vanilla health, hunger, armor, air and XP with RPG indicators; preserves the hotbar.
options.rustpg.damage_meter.tip: Tracks your own final server-verified hits, damage total and combo.
options.rustpg.power_hud: Show relic power and cooldown on HUD
options.rustpg.slot.head: Helmet
options.rustpg.hud_y_offset.tip: Moves the HUD above the hotbar to avoid touch controls.
entity.rustpg.mana_hound.description: A rift predator that stores mana beneath its hide. Its dorsal spines flare before an aggressive pounce.
entity.rustpg.grave_knight.description: An undead warrior bound to funerary armor. It advances slowly, but its blade strikes are heavy.
entity.rustpg.rift_mantis.description: A mana-fed insect with scythe-shaped arms. It attacks in short bursts and changes direction quickly.
entity.rustpg.crystal_wyrm.description: An arcane serpent plated in conductive crystal. Its segmented body pulses while gathering energy.
entity.rustpg.eclipse_ogre.description: A giant marked by a crimson core in its chest. This brute-force boss alternates slow steps with violent smashes.
entity.rustpg.dusk_revenant.description: A spectral fighter guarding the boundary between worlds.
entity.rustpg.storm_gryphon.description: An arcane flying predator that plunges from the storm clouds.
entity.rustpg.rune_colossus.description: Ancient living-stone guardian, awakened by the glow of its sigils.
entity.rustpg.ember_imp.description: A skittish little demon that gathers in packs around burning fractures.
entity.rustpg.abyss_weaver.description: A subterranean spider attuned to magic and vibrations.
